assessments.name: Methodological Portfolio
assessments.description: Throughout the semester, students complete the weekly data/analytical tasks in the Practicum sessions. They select four of these completed exercises, compile them into an empirical portfolio and prefaced it with a 500-word reflection.
assessments.dueRaw: Formal exam period Due date : 20 Nov 2026 at 23:59 Closing date : 30 Nov 2026

assessments.name: Formal "Reviewer Report"
assessments.description: Students are provided with an anonymous, unpolished draft of a qualitative methods chapter or working paper. They must act as an anonymous journal referee or dissertation examiner and write a comprehensive, 3-page "Reviewer Report."

assessments.name: Methodological Research Paper
assessments.description: Students produce a written artifact tailored to their current dissertation stage
